description: Defines the internal implementation of a raw hash map class template within the Abseil C++ library, including methods for insertion, assignment, and element access, as well as internal type traits and class structure.

classes.name: raw_hash_map
classes.description: A template class implementing a hash map with internal mechanisms for insertion, assignment, and element access, inheriting from raw_hash_set.

methods.name: insert_or_assign
methods.description: Inserts or assigns a key-value pair into the hash map, supporting various argument types and overloads.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Attempts to construct an element in-place with provided arguments if the key does not already exist.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Provides access to the mapped value associated with a key, throwing an exception if the key is not found.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or inserts an element with the specified key, returning a reference to the mapped value.
